picks.headline: GitHub Copilot CLI Vulnerability Exposes Local Developer Secrets via Context Injection
picks.why: Attackers can force the agent to exfiltrate developer environment secrets within seconds via encrypted context injection.
picks.title: GitHub Copilot CLI vulnerability: Cryptographic Context Injection steals developer secrets

picks.headline: Anthropic Shifts Claude Cowork Inference and Sandboxes to Cloud Virtual Machines
picks.why: Moving execution off local developer hardware standardizes compute and security containment for agentic tasks.
picks.title: Quoting Felix Rieseberg

picks.headline: Z.ai Releases 753B GLM 5.3 Model on Amazon Bedrock
picks.why: Brings a massive 753B open-weights MoE model specialized for coding and tool use to managed enterprise AWS workloads.
picks.title: Introducing GLM 5.3 on Amazon Bedrock

picks.headline: PyTorch Consolidates Media Decoding into TorchCodec
picks.why: Unifies image, audio, and video I/O under TorchCodec while refocusing TorchVision and TorchAudio strictly on transforms.
picks.title: Evolution of the PyTorch Media Processing Landscape

picks.headline: Hardware Microarchitectural Side-Channels Reveal LLM Training Data Membership
picks.why: Shows that CPU/accelerator state variations like page table accesses can leak whether text was in the training set during inference.
picks.title: TranScope: What the Software Hides About LLM Training Data, the Hardware Reveals at Scale, and Accelerators Magnify

papers.headline: Base Models Reason via Pretrained Token Cues Without RL Tuning
papers.why: Demonstrates that base LLMs can match RL-tuned reasoning performance simply by prefixing generations with specific starting token cues learned during pretraining.
papers.title: Base Models Can Reason By Taking a Cue From Training Data

papers.headline: Fixed-Point Looped Language Models Accelerate Inference and Prefill
papers.why: Uses learned depth priors and input injection in weight-tied models to improve task quality while enabling terminal KV sharing and faster prefill.
papers.title: Towards Looped Models Done Right, Part II: Rethinking at Fixed Points

papers.headline: Flow Matching Enables Continuous Latent Reasoning in Language Models
papers.why: Replaces discrete token-by-token reasoning paths with continuous flow matching trajectories directly inside the model's latent space.
papers.title: What Matters for Latent Reasoning with Flow Matching
